scope: Manufactured terminal lifecycle fixtures only; no game process, source archive, saves/profiles, captured-state policy replay, search experiment or complete attempt.
baseline_expected_failure: last permitted result hard-stops without creating Resume allowance
behavior: The next fresh terminal controller observation checks goal availability/completion and the reached run cap before the product can dismiss its exact owned result overlay. Reached-cap status retains max_runs, runs_started, outcome and action counts and displays a human-readable run-limit message. Under-cap result dismissal and later search remain separate updates.
notes: The final outcome is still recorded in the earlier controller tick exactly once.
Collection completion now retains its result overlay and takes precedence over the run cap.
Ordinary input waits block overlay dismissal and defer the same fresh terminal decision until settled.
No release metadata, install tree or documentation finalization changed.
